main_text.p: Hierarchicum occæcantem fastum fævientemque tyran-nidem in scenam produci? Sparsim perspicies in controver-siis Hierarchicis prosequendis, multaque hujusmodi Hie-rarchiam Romanam spirantia. Sed non adeo promissis de-tinendus es ac dimittendus ad vindemiam ipsam. Opus ejus, messis tua est, si perlegas, releges, & fructum colliges, hoc si feceris, & fruaris, optatis etiam fruimur: utere igi-tur, fruere & Vale.

page.notes: Faint or grey words in the middle of the text ("Sparsim perspicies", "multaque hujusmodi") are show-through or light print and were read as printed. The text is in Latin with long s, transcribed as plain s; "&" is kept as printed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
